name: The Sun-Wheel and Mt. Kanna
description: Whether you're here to help Ruu or finish the commission, it's time to head to Tsurumi Island once more.

steps.description: Touch the feather that suddenly appeared
Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu and the others at the designated location
Head to the designated location to investigate
Talk to Ruu and the others at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location
Talk to Ruu at the designated location

dialogs.content: Eh? Kama? What are you doing here?
The situation looks rather grim.
Yeah, the sky's looking all strange and stuff...
"This" Tsurumi Island is about to be destroyed. And then, everything will start again.
Ah, that's the thing that you talked about yesterday...
However, it seems that things are even more serious than when I came here previously. Perhaps it's because you destroyed those perches...
The name of the child you're trying to help... it's "Ruu," right?
If we want to break the cycle and free Ruu, now is the time.
That's why I'm here. To help.
Did Miss Sumida ask you to do it?
No, I've come here of my own accord.
What!? You're volunteering, Kama?
I don't know why either. I just feel like... I should be here. How should I describe that feeling... Ah. Right. It's like this.
"Perhaps I simply find it intolerably shameless for me to play the fly on the wall as you boldly step into Tsurumi Island."
"Perhaps I believe that even illusions have feelings, and so I would do ill in allowing them to suffer in this cycle."
"Or perhaps I simply think that I might help Ruu by breaking this perpetual ocean of fog, and in fulfilling the wishes of my ancestors I shall be freed from the 'history' that binds me."
Huh. Kama, since when were you...
So eloquent and loquacious?
Yes, Lady Sumida did speak these words. When I told her that I would like to help, she suddenly gained a spark of inspiration.
I did not understand what she said, but I believe that since Lady Sumida said so, then that must be how things are.
That sounds like her style alright...
Still, Paimon thinks yesterday's events have probably made Ruu too angry to talk to us...
I know. Lady Sumida said that "In this manner, the bloodline spanning millennia shall..."
Could we lose the verbatim quotes?
We shall. I believe that "Kama" — that is to say, I — can speak to him.
Hmm...
Well...
It's true that you do look just like the illusory Kama that we saw earlier.
Ruu did also mention that being unable to speak to those illusions weirded him out and worried him.
So being able to talk to you should cheer him right up!
Hmm, but where do we find Ruu...
You know, he did mention...
Ooh, you're right!
Wakukau, Oina, and Autake... He did mention that these places wouldn't be hit by lightning under these circumstances.
And those would be his hiding spots where he'd wait out the storm.
Well, let's go looking, then. Let's start with Wakukau Shoal.
Kama seems pretty enthusiastic today, eh...
There's a few places the storm doesn't touch.
There is a very strong resemblance, yes.
Could we get to the point?
So much like a light novelist?
Those were Miss Sumida's words, weren't they...
You should probably leave this island.
...I thought Kapatcir had forgotten about all this...
I thought that this happened because she didn't approve of the ceremony. Because she didn't like me...
You said that she was your friend.
Friends don't forget their friends' words that easily!
She's been waiting for you to sing for her all this time.
Yes, you're right.
I did tell her that I would sing for her.
But I haven't seen her in an awful long time now...
(Should we tell him? Y'know, that the Thunderbird was killed on Seirai Island...)
(How should we put this?)
Um, so, Ruu...
The Thunderbird has—
—Migrated to Seirai Island!
Uh, Y—Yeah, that's right! Didn't we tell you before that we saw this huge storm-cloud and a shattered mountain on Seirai Island?
That's where the Thunderbird lives now! Y'know, we wanted to go up to Amakumo Peak to see the awesome face of the Great Thunderbird...
But the Thunderbird was super busy...
That's right, and she's had lots of baby thunderbirds too! They're all up in the clouds right now, though, and they don't come down much!
Baby thunderbirds...?
So there's this vortex-like storm cloud over Seirai Island...
Yeah! That's formed by Kapatcir and the little thunderbirds as they play and fly in circles!
Wow, that's amazing! I mean, I've never seen it with my own eyes, but it already sounds unbelievably amazing!
Kapatcir must have been even mightier than I imagined!
And we did say before that we'd go outside on adventures together, didn't we?
#Yes, I remember. You did say that we'd go see other places, {NICKNAME}.
Wanna go to Seirai Island together?
Even if she's busy and you can't see her...
Wow! Could I really?
Of course you can.
#Yup, we had an agreement, remember? {NICKNAME}'s not one to go back on {F#her}{M#his} word!
Awesome!
But I've tried leaving Tsurumi Island before, and I always end up back here again...
Eh? Huh. That is a bit of a problem...
There has to be a way. Let's discuss the matter.
Paimon would like to ask Kama some things as well! Hang on a sec, Ruu.
Alright!
That's right. It was our agreement.
Wanna go sing for Kapatcir?
(This will be tough.)
Well, that's finally over...
Phew, Paimon really broke a sweat back there!
Uh huh, and you were doing the fighting, eh?
Oh, come on, Paimon's palms were getting all clammy watching you fight!
#Wow, I saw everything! That was so cool, {NICKNAME}! So cool!
Hehe.
You truly were impressive. That was very eye-opening.
Hmm, Paimon's still concerned about something...
Why... would there be this sort of monster here...
We fought one before back on Amakumo Peak.
Yeah, Paimon remembers that one too, but...
We seem to be forgetting something important...
The "feather."
Ooh! That's right!
What's this gotta do with feathers?
So earlier, we took a commission from the Adventurers' Guild and went to Seirai Island to investigate...
...A talking cat?
Wow! A talking cat? Really?
Uh, that's... not the main point!
So while we were investigating Amakumo Peak, we defeated a monster just like this one, after which we got this special feather.
#Oh, so that's where you got your Thunderbird feather, {NICKNAME}...
That means that the Thunder Manifestations that appeared here and on Amakumo Peak must have something to do with the Thunderbird.
If Sumida were here, she'd say something like...
"This plot is getting too complicated."
Heh, funny.
You don't look like you found it funny, Kama.
No, no, I did find it quite amusing.
#Still, Paimon thinks that we've got a good picture of what's going on now, eh, {NICKNAME}?
Well, almost, but...
True, we should go confirm our suspicions anyway.
Let's be extra sure.
That said, Paimon thinks we've more or less got it already.
"This sounds like good foreshadowing material."
I do this all the time.
...You know what? This story is even more bizarre than the plot of "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog (Working Title)."
Also, stop calling me "Lady" this and "Lady" that already. You're an important friend of mine.
Understood, Lady Sumida.
Oh, come on... Should I call you a pedant for the ages, or...
Hello there.
#Oh my, oh my! It's the legendary {NICKNAME}...
"And Paimon's the legendary Paimon!"
Huh, funny. Shouldn't she make some retort at this juncture? This feels like we're departing from her character profile somehow...
"Character profile"?
Basically, that's what we call a combination of "image, traits, and history." Characters must adhere to the behavior prescribed in their profiles, or they will seem, well, out of character.
People aren't machines, you know.
S—Sorry...
So, what about Ruu...
Ruu says he's thankful to you.
Is that so? I see.
Wait, what happened? Why am I the only person who seems out of the loop here?
Ugh, never mind. Let's not stand around here. A change of scenery is in order, I think!
How about Kiminami Restaurant?
Sure. I'll pay. Consider this treat courtesy of a future contracted writer with Yae Publishing House and winner of the "This Novel is Amazing" grand prize!
I agreed to take Paimon out for a good meal.
Seriously, what's your problem?
Have some consideration for the feelings of others, please.
Huh. So the storm really doesn't reach this place.
But Paimon doesn't see Ruu anywhere either...
Ruu—
Ruu—
Where are you? We're here to help—
...Looks like nobody's home.
Alright.
Ahhhh—
No, no, not like that! We're looking for something more like, "Ruu, it's Kama, where are you"!
Ruu, it's Kama, where are you—
Still no response. Ohh, Paimon's getting worried...
Still, why is there no thunder or lightning here?
Well, since it was the Thunderbird who destroyed Tsurumi Island...
Oh, right! The "feather" from before!
Hmm, yeah, that's worth a try. Since Ruu said that it's one of the Thunderbird's feathers, we might get some reaction...
We could try using the power of the "feather."
Come on, Kama, you try.
Ah, it flew away...
What happened? Paimon was worried sick, you know...
It seems that I was drawn into the Thunderbird's memories.
Eh? The Thunderbird... The same one that destroyed Tsurumi Island?
I can't be sure.
Hmm, if that's the case...
It's just like Lady Sumida said. The will of the Thunderbird will resurface.
In that case, the voice that we heard during the battle...
Was it a hallucination?
Nope, Paimon heard it too!
Hmm, Paimon's very curious now. It's almost like the Thunderbird was looking for someone...
Still, that feather sure did bring about some kinda reaction, huh?
Yes, I saw you take out a strange feather earlier. Where did you get that?
Well, this is how it went...
Huh. So the feathers of the Thunderbird were the basis for the Maushiro, and can summon spirits...
I was told these legends by my grandfather as he taught me how to make those Maushiro.
Ooh, so you can make 'em, huh! Then couldn't you just have made one for Lady... Err, Sumida?
Well, because Lady Sumida did not ask. But if I should have the chance to help her in the future, I will mention this matter.
Still, what shall we do next? The direction in which the feather flew away doesn't quite match up with Oina Beach or Autake Plains...
Tsurumi Island is in a lot of danger.
Yes, and we are on borrowed time as well. This will all start again once the thunder stops.
Well, let's forget about the feather's whereabouts for now. We've gotta get to the other spots where there's "no thunder" and look for Ruu there!
Alright then. Next stop, Oina Beach!
As long as we can talk to him, there's hope!
We haven't much time...
Yup, and Ruu said that things get real wild when the thunder starts coming down.
It might've been the Thunderbird.
There's no way to establish that at the moment.
Huh, what's this? Looks like a feather...
(Touch the feather)
Whoa, be careful...
#...{NICKNAME}! Hey, {NICKNAME}!
What happened?
That was close. You were just frozen to the spot back there...
This feather's just like the last one.
(Touch the feather)
Don't worry, Paimon will watch over you...
Ruu—
We've chased the monsters away—
#Ah, {NICKNAME}, you're back!
This one flew away too.
It doesn't look like Ruu's here either...
The feather's target seems to have been the mountain at the center of the island.
Kama, do you know anything about that mountain?
Mt. Kanna? It was where the Thunderbird reposed.
That place is in fact a hollow cavern from which the Thunderbird would take off into the skies like a violet meteor that could be seen even through the fog.
It was said by the people of Tsurumi Island that the Thunderbird dispersed that mysterious fog to protect the island...
That's not what happened.
Eh? So you're saying...
(You relate the memories that came to you when you touched the feather.)
...That this fog wasn't created by the Thunderbird?
Huh. Perhaps our ancestors were wrong.
Well, that's understandable, considering that you can barely see the sun or the moon from down here. Maybe the Thunderbird's light was the only light they'd ever see.
Speaking of your ancestors...
Ah, that's right. We saw someone who looked like an ancient version of you, Kama.
Here's what went down...
(You talk about "Sayo" and "Kama" from earlier.)
...And that's what happened. They seemed to be pretty friendly with Ruu.
Hmm. That may truly have been my ancestor.
So, did the ancient Kama meet Sayo after leaving Tsurumi Island?
The records don't say anything about that.
Huh...
Well, where shall we go next?
We'll keep looking for Ruu, of course! Let's see where the next spot is...
The Autake Plains, I think.
Yeah! We've been there before, too!
Well then, let's go!
Mt. Kanna.
Huh? Paimon thinks we should go to the Autake Plains first...
To Amakumo Peak, perhaps?
Oh come on, let's focus on Tsurumi Island first! We should go to the Autake Plains next!
That conflicts with what I saw in those memories.
This is the last possible location.
Ruu—
Ruu— We're here to help—
Ruu—
Eh? What's that weird noise...
Yikes! Monsters! Be careful!
#{NICKNAME}, Paimon, didn't I tell you not to come here anymore...?
It's good to see that you're alright.

But this place is super dangerous! There's thunder and lightning everywhere, and if you get struck by lightning, you'll get hurt! And I don't know why, but it looks like the storm's getting scarier than before...
It must because you hurt that perch... Why did you come back... *sobs*
Ruu...
We brought Kama to come see you.
Kama...?
"I'm back."
Big Brother Kama... Is that really you?
Eh!? Wait, are you an... illusion too, Kama?
Oh. Lady Sumida told me to say this.
Come on, this isn't the time for tricks.
Oh. Sorry.
The Kama you knew led a full life after leaving Tsurumi Island. His greatest regret was not being able to help you.
#I'm a descendant of his. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and I are here to help you.
Descendant... Are you his son, then?
I'm afraid you're quite a few generations off...
Wait, I don't get it. Descendants... Does that mean that Big Brother Kama is no longer around?
It's been a long time, you know...
What happened to him after he left?
I waited for so, so long, until Tsurumi Island started looking like this, but he and Big Sister Sayo never returned. I've been so worried...
Well, I do know a little about what happened to the Kama you knew. If you'd like to listen, I could tell you.
That'd be great!
...So many things happened in the outside world, huh...
I never knew that the world beyond the fog was so big, or that it had so many people...
The unchanging nature of Tsurumi Island is the abnormal thing here.
Yup, and that's why we're here to help!
Help...
But you destroyed the Perches and made Kapatcir angry...
If the ceremony goes smoothly and she accepts me and our sacrifice, then everything will be fine again...
That might not be what the Thunderbird wants...
#But how would you know, {NICKNAME}? You haven't met Kapatcir.
She hasn't come back in so long. She must be angry...
I can't say this for sure, but...
Mmhmm. Let's give it a try.
Let me introduce you two...
Curious tunes, tiny human. Afraid not of thunder and storms?
Eh...? Is this... the first time I met Kapatcir?
The adults in the village all said that I can bring peace to thunder and storms.
Huh, this memory is clearer than before... Is that because Ruu is here?
I was too embarrassed to sing in the village, so I came here to practice!
Do you like it? Hehe...

Before you humans learned to make fire, the thundering storm had already swept across the ocean alongside me. With but a flap of my wings, purple lightning will tear through the clouds like serpents. My cry shakes the ocean depths and heart of the earth.

I have heard the songs of the trees, the strains of the cloud and rain, and the melodies sung by the blue flying dragon of the far north. I have heard every trembling chorus of fox and rabbit and worm as I descended upon the land.
But your song is special. It is different from that of the boar, the fish, and the Wen Kamuy.
You're speaking all funny. I don't get it...
But I guess you like my song, then?
I do not know. I only know that I have never heard it before.
Well, then I shall sing you another tune — when you come again with thunder and rain!
Your lives are fragile and puny. Perhaps you shall already have turned to dust before I remember this matter. But if you have not, then you shall sing for me again.
Everything you say is so complicated...
Oh, yes! My name's Ruu. What's yours? Everyone in the village calls you "Great Thunderbird," but you must have a name, right?
A name?
Well, that is... What should I call you? I mean, if I want to sing for you again, and I call out to you, what shall I call out?
I do not know. She gave me a name long ago, but I have forgotten it. I do not need such things, nor have any dared to summon me thusly—
Well, how about this then? Dad... I mean, Grandpa Mata taught me a few new words in the Ishine Script today. Let me try using them to give you a name!
Hmm... Oh! Oh, this should do!
And so I gave her the name Kanna Kapatcir...
Let's name you "Kanna K{RUBY#[S]Great Eagle of the Storm}apatcir," then!
...Ridiculous. Still, it matters not to me.
Well, it's decided, then! I need to get back now, or the adults will worry. I'll definitely sing for you again!
Hah. Perhaps I shall forget you immediately, "Ruu."
Well, I won't forget! See you!
Ah, it flew away...
It flew off to Mt. Kanna...
Are those... Kapatcir's memories?
They should be.
Well, you did give her a name, after all.
She also remembered my promise to sing for her again.
But... But if that's the case, why did everyone become like this? Why did the village become like this?
Did we anger Kapatcir by not performing the ceremony correctly?
I don't think that this was what the Thunderbird was mad about...
I see. I understand now, more or less.
Well then, I suppose our next stop is Mt. Kanna.
But that's sacred ground. We can't set foot there...
#And {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you've already come around three times, and yet things haven't gotten better...
Well, you're the one who talked about "The Rule of Three."
"Good omens must occur three times for good fortune to truly descend."
And "You must forge past obstacles three times to succeed on the fourth."
...You know what? Paimon still thinks this should be called the "Rule of Four" instead!
*sigh* Maybe you're right, Paimon...
#True. You've already met with three difficulties, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.
That we have.
Alright. I believe you.
And since Kama... I mean, Kama's descendant has also returned, this must mean that good things are in store for us...
But if nothing good happens, I'll be very, very mad, you hear?
Of course. Let's go, then.
She always remembered you.
...Since you have allowed this one and only song to flow in blood into this earth...
Then until I, Kanna K{RUBY#[S]Great Eagle of the Storm}apatcir, hear that human... "Ruu"'s song once more, may these lands fall under an eternal catastrophe...
So that's what happened.
It's as I thought.
Huh, so that's what happened. And here I thought...
It's a bit more extreme than I imagined...
Kama!
What is it?
Were you about to say that the Thunderbird is dead or something?
What? No! I was going to talk about a story that Lady Sumida told me.
Who do you take me for, seriously? How could I tell a child like Ruu such a thing?
C'mon, Paimon, have a little faith.
P—Paimon was just... Well...
Ugh, enough already! So, about getting Ruu off Tsurumi Island...
He says that he can't leave this place...
Perhaps Tsurumi Island sustains his existence in some way...
Hmm... If that's the case...
From what we've learned so far, the strange happenings on Tsurumi Island were caused by the Thunderbird destroying it.
It feels like we can follow this line of reasoning to find a solution...
We could use the Thunderbird's feathers...
Ah!
#Paimon gets what you're trying to say, {NICKNAME}! If the state of Tsurumi Island now is due to ley line disorders caused by the Thunderbird's power...
Then this feather, which also has that same power, might be able to sustain Ruu's existence.
Are we on the same page?
Basically.
You know what? I think you'd get along with Lady Sumida just fine.
Huh, Paimon's not sure if you're complimenting us or...
She told me a story once, about a god of fertility who dwelt within the wheat fields, and who would travel afar with a human...
Paimon doesn't wanna be mean or anything, but you're picking up her habit of going off topic, Kama...
But whatever the case, since we've decided what to do, let's just give it a try! It's better than nothing, after all!
Agreed. Well, if you don't mind, I shan't accompany you on this particular trip.
I'd like to take this opportunity to have a look at the place where my ancestors once stayed.
But it's storming outside...
I know. I'll be fine, don't worry.
I mean, we live in Inazuma. Stormy days are our bread and butter.
Not precisely, but let's go with your idea, Paimon.
Very clever, Paimon.
Hehehe, of course!
Um, let's leave that topic aside for now...
Well, how are we going to get Ruu to Seirai Island, anyway?
I can leave now, woohoo!
You're back!
Ready to go?
Yup! Anytime!
Well then, touch this Thunderbird feather first...
For good luck? Sure!
So this is the heart of Tsurumi Island...
I should bring Lady Sumida next time. I'm sure this sight would inspire her.
So, up there, that's...
That's Amakumo Peak.
That's right! The Thunderbird... Kapatcir's up there in the sky.
She's a little busy and can't come down to hear you sing. But if you do, Paimon's sure she'll hear you!
Mmhmm.
#{NICKNAME}, Paimon...
Actually, I know all about it. Or should I say I've guessed what happened to Kapatcir... and to me.
Oh...
Well, Ruu, we...
No, it's alright. I'm so glad I got to know you! I mean, you even got me off Tsurumi Island to see the world outside!
I could never have imagined that I could do this in the past. You're both really awesome!
The clouds in the sky, the super special grass, and rocks up in the air. These were all Kapatcir's doing, right? She's so cool, too!
Even the air smells different. I mean, I'm not used to it, but it's amazing!
Well then, the weather's not the same anymore, but I've come to sing you a song, Kapatcir.
That's the Thunderbird's territory.
Phew! I sure haven't sung in a long time. That was great!
I'm sure Kapatcir heard me, too...
I'm sure she did.
Let's head back, then.
I'd like to send this feather back to Kapatcir's home.
Huh, how strange. I've only been away for a while, but it feels like it's been ages...
I'm back, and so is Kapatcir.
Ah, it's so beautiful...
If only I could have seen such sights together with everyone...
Ah, but I'm happy just to be able to do it with you two!
Still, the world beyond the fog is amazing! I never knew the sky was so high up or so large.
I wonder what the places Kama went to were like...
We can go see those places.
That's right! The outside world is a reeeally big place.
We've met lots of interesting and nice people along the way, too. You'll hit it off with them in no time!
There's loads and loads of awesome food, too! Sweet Madames, Almond Tofu, Sticky Honey Roasts...
Ooh! Sweet Madames sounds like they'll be great!
#That's right, we've had a ton of those in our journey, haven't we, {NICKNAME}?
Ooh, yeah! We also met a certain Tone-Deaf Bard during our journey. He loves music too.
Paimon's sure you two would be the best of friends. Maybe you'll even perform together in Mondstadt's city square!
#And... And... We can take you on adventures! {NICKNAME}'s a real ace at that! We'll go to all sorts of places, like the super high-up Wangshu Inn...
Yup, I know, and I'd love to follow you all outside as well.
#Thank you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.
It's all thanks to you that I was able to fulfill my promise with Kapatcir. And... I guess everyone doesn't look all weird anymore.
I'm sorry.
I thought that you'd broken the Perches, and I blamed you for that... Even though you're both good people.
It's alright! We've been on lots of adventures and got ourselves into a ton of misunderstandings. Don't take it to heart.
And even if you don't wanna travel with us, we've got friends who'll take care of you! We know a young lady your age in Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius...
So... Please leave Tsurumi Island with us, Ruu...
I... When we went to Seirai Island to sing for Kapatcir, I could feel that a piece of me was in that feather.
That's why I'd like you to take that feather of hers on your travels.
This way, I can travel with the two of you as well. We'll even bring Kapatcir with us, too!
We'll go see the outside world, and we'll hear what songs they have to sing.
But...
Paimon.
Yup, you don't have to worry about me!
It was great going outside, but it was real tiring, too...
I'd like to rest for a bit. You can go on ahead first!
Oh, that's right! Could you please thank Big Brother Kama for me?
We will. See you around.
Yup! Let's meet again.
We'll definitely meet again!
Well then, anything you want to eat? Don't be shy, now!
You too, Kama! As for me, I'll start with a Tri-Flavored Skewer...
Phew, Paimon's full. Feeling much better now, too!
You can have some more if you like.
Thank you, Miss Sumida!
It's no problem. I've been troubling you all this time, after all.
The commission has been successfully completed. Indeed, I'd say the results far surpass my expectations...
I'd only wanted to get one Maushiro at first to use as reference for my writing.
But thanks to your perseverance, I not only got that, but also the story of the Sea of Fog, and of the millennia-spanning wait of a young lad on Tsurumi Island.
Mm... If my writing was better, this story would win me the "This Novel Is Amazing!" grand prize for sure!
But Kama's also changed quite a bit... I'd say these are all far more important than the completion of "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog (Working Title)."
We've also met some important friends...
We didn't have a chance to travel with Ruu, but like he said, we'll definitely meet again.
He'll keep his word.
Yup! Paimon's sure he will. After all, he waited for so long just to keep his other promise!
Well then, Miss Sumida, when will we get to read "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog"?
Uh, well, this...
I've decided to stop writing it for now.
Wait, what!? But we worked so hard to...
Ah, no, it's not an issue with you. Please don't misunderstand!
I wish to go traveling next.
To gather more reference material?
I... I learned something very important during this commission.
In the years prior to this, I lived only to create and write.

I learned fishing from Kujirai to write about a character who fishes for a living. His character profile was that of a masterful warrior who secluded himself in a fishing village and lived a peaceful life there, until...
Ahem.

Oh, right. Sorry... I almost went off-topic again. So, in order to better describe parties conducting illicit activities under a fictional national lock-down, Kama and I created a smuggling network that bypassed the Outlander Affairs Agency.
Well, it was mostly Kama's doing. And we discarded that work due to a writing bottleneck, which eventually resulted in the collapse of that network.

I've always been like this. I stopped fishing because I stopped writing that fisherman character. I went to apprentice at the Grand Narukami Shrine because I wanted to write about a shrine maiden's work...
But I understand now that I cannot just live, learn, travel, and adventure for the sake of writing novels.
I must live, learn, travel, adventure, and extract stories from there from which I shall write novels.
Kama was not born as the last son of Tsurumi Island for the sake of a story. Nor did Ruu stay in the Sea of Fog for so many years to be featured in a tale...
And that's not why the two of you adventure and travel either, right? When I heard Miss Katheryne describe your adventures, I thought to myself...
That you're just like the main character Kino in "Kino's Travels" and her companion "Hermos." The only difference is that no one has written your story. You are the story itself.

#A pair of outlanders who don't quite fit in anywhere, whose names are {NICKNAME} and Paimon! They stride across many strange lands and meet all sorts of people. They are drawn into all kinds of wicked plots and all manner of cruel wars. And each one of their adventures shall coalesce into shining gold...
As Paimon has mentioned before, such a blurb would definitely suit you two.
